name: io.github.martinopedal/mcp-server-azure-architect
title: Azure Architect MCP Server
description: ALZ checklist queries, readiness scorecard, and Azure retail pricing lookups for architects.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure tenant ID. Optional when using 'az login' or managed identity.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Service principal or managed identity client ID. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Service principal secret. Optional, prefer 'az login' or managed identity.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Azure subscription ID for Resource Graph queries. Optional.
